message.jaymospowers.gravity_planets.hun: Too hungry to throw a planet.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_wind.waiting: The others hold the day still.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_wind.ask: A Chrono would turn the day: crouch to let it.
message.jaymospowers.airless.wait: The air has not come back yet: %s s
message.jaymospowers.darktide.cooling: The dark has not gathered again yet.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.pit_ground: No ground there for a pit.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.choked: A hand of shadow at your throat: you can't use your powers.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.no_water: No water near, none carried, and too little Flow to wring it out.
item.jaymospowers.web_cartridge.kind.sti: Sticky web: webs up what it hits
item.jaymospowers.web_cartridge.kind.con: Concussive: no web, a hard thump that throws back and leaves them reeling
item.jaymospowers.web_cartridge.kind.tas: Taser: shocks what it hits still, and the charge jumps to one beside it
item.jaymospowers.web_cartridge.kind.spl: Splitter: a charged Web Shot leaves as three
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.fall_none: Look at a foe to open the gates round it
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.fall_refuse: The gates won't take that one
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.fall_room: No room over it for the second gate
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.surface_wai: The rift won't open upward yet: %ss
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.surface_non: There's nowhere safe to stand above you
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.seal_wait: The Rift Seal won't close again yet: %ss
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.seal_spread: Rift Seal: %s blocks (let go to close it)
message.jaymospowers.zfighter.reel_none: No foe within reach of your arm
message.jaymospowers.zfighter.reel_block: Your arm can't find a way round to it
talk.jaymospowers.keeper.tracker_poor: "%s, friend. The wind is free; brass isn't."
talk.jaymospowers.keeper.tracker_sold: "The wind up here carries everything, and a little of it is in that needle now. It turns to whatever great thing is near. Go carefully."
